title: Payroll
subtitle: Base salary + KPI bonus + commission + other bonuses − penalty
calculateHint: Commission is the total of approved commissions for the month. Base salary, bonuses and penalties are entered manually and kept on recalculation.
noFixedHint: Only managers and Sales heads (ROP) have a base salary. Executors are paid piece rates.
emptyOwn: Payroll for this month has not been generated yet.
kpiBonusTargetHint: Saved in the employee profile; the monthly KPI bonus = amount × KPI achievement (up to 120%)

errors.noFixed: Only managers and Sales heads (ROP) have a fixed base salary
errors.noFixedField: This role has no base salary: piece rate, bonuses, KPI
errors.payApproved: Only approved payroll can be paid

kpiBonusAutoHint: If you change “KPI bonus at 100%”, the amount is recalculated based on KPI achievement
salariesHint: Managers and sales heads. When the month is calculated, the salary is multiplied by attendance against the work schedule: half a day counts as 50% of the day. Vacation, sick leave and absences are not paid from the salary — add a bonus if needed.
salariesEmpty: No active managers or sales heads
salariesSaved: Salaries saved. Recalculate the month to apply them
baseManualHint: The salary is calculated from attendance. A manual change applies to this month only; the 100% salary is changed in the “Salaries” block.
smmHint: Executors with an SMM specialty. Monthly salary = salary at 100% × published / video plan (capped at 100%). Piece-rate pay for projects stays as is.
smmEmpty: No active executors with an SMM specialty
smmColumns: Left — salary at 100% of the plan, right — videos per month. Empty plan — no salary is accrued.
smmSaved: Video plan saved. Recalculate the month to apply it
